headword: {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}

definitions.explanation: Work that primarily requires physical strength and effort, such as construction or farming.

notes:
Work that primarily requires physical strength and effort, such as construction, farming, or warehouse work. A compound of ⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧ (physical body) and ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧ (labor). Often contrasted with ⟦{頭脳|ずのう}→頭脳：00438_zunou⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧ (intellectual work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to engage in physical labor
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}{者|しゃ}: manual laborer
- ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}: heavy physical labor
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: centered on manual labor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭脳|ずのう}→頭脳：00438_zunou⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: intellectual labor; mental work — the opposite
